text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The season of Classic races had come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps influenced by St Lite, the very first Classic Triple Crown Umamusume... this year's Classic races were more thrilling than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—If so, what's next?"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: This year's Classic races were played at a really high level too~

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Racing really is fun after all!
Let's see, the next feature race is...—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"The Japan Cup, where the strongest is decided...
and the Arima Kinen, where the strongest gather! Right!?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nothing but the absolute strongest!
Every single race was so thrilling, though,
you can't help but get your hopes up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The weight of everyone's expectations can be felt clearly.
Now is the time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to discuss what kind of race
we should show the fans, I entered
the Chairwoman's office, and—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
“—The three of us have actually
been discussing this for a while now.”

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Please make sure to inform the Chairwoman of this matter as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
...I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Excuse me, should we come back later?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It's all right.
We just finished talking.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall leave it in your care.
—Tazuna-chan.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: And so... what is it you require of me?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Your actions have planted the
seeds of fate. The fruits they
bore will provide your answer.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "What ought to be given has already been determined... That is what this means."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Everything you have witnessed this past year...
The answer surely lies within.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
What is it... that our audience
truly desires from us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliant, shining smile of St Lite...
Basking in that majesty, I reflect on everything until now—"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: "Uooooooooh...!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Who, who will seize the victory...!?
Who will be crowned the strongest this year—
Who will take the glory—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What sent them into a frenzy was...
a clash of sheer resolve,
a serious showdown between true titans.
choice_data_list: (If so, then what I look forward to beyond that is—)

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—The theme for this year's "Dream Fest"
has been decided.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: 『Pride』。

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"With your pride as the strongest on the line,
compete against each other."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait... what do you mean?
Isn't it just a festival race like before?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest...? Meaning we have
to go at each other even harder?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, not just any all-star lineup.
Transcending generations—no, eras...
We gather the Umamusume hailed as the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if Umamusume worthy of the Classic Triple Crown
or the Triple Tiara were to face off...
Who would come out on top?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —In other words.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"So those who have reached the pinnacle
shall clash with one another, I take it?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How intriguing! In that case, naturally,
my name must be on it as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—What about you?
Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Surely you do not intend to play the bystander
in front of this signboard?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I have no need for cheap provocations.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Very well. I, too, have a wall that I must tear down."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —It is a royal command.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu.
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: “—First, I shall take your heads. Take your marks.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I wonder if a neck is enough to satisfy you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's insolent designation sent a chill through the Umamusume all at once.
However, she didn't stop talking—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, there were others.
I shall continue—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
This is bound to become even more intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, the trainers somehow managed to calm things down before the tense atmosphere escalated any further.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
However, thanks to you,
we should be able to fulfill the theme.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Once this is announced to the public, I'm certain everyone will be absolutely thrilled.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Please rejoice in the fact
that <chrname>'s name is among them.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Because she, too, has what it takes to be the strongest.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Still, those spirited expressions
on everyone's faces...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: It is truly, remarkably beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As St Lite muttered those words,
the image of her racing days overlapped with her...
In the next instant, without thinking—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Let me stop you right there.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I have fulfilled the mission given to me
with utter perfection.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Those were the most brilliant days
of my entire life...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Besides... no,
it's not quite time for this yet.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
All I can say is,
it is wonderful inside the mansion.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"One more thing...
My children are utterly adorable."
